feeds.title: That Eric Alper
feeds.description: Eric Alper is a Freelance Music Publicist. He is a SiriusXM Host. He've been named to Billboard Magazine, Paste Magazine and The National Post's best on social media, and honoured to be on Canadian Music Week's Advisory Board and The City of Toronto's Music Industry Advisory Council. He loves to talk about music.

feeds.title: The Spill Magazine
feeds.description: The Spill Magazine is a Toronto-based online publication dedicated to covering the independent music scene with a strong focus on our thriving hometown talent.

feeds.title: A Journal of Musical Things
feeds.description: A Journal of Musical Things is a music blog that filters what's happening in music and music technology to save you time, money and effort.

feeds.title: Toronto Sun
feeds.description: Toronto's best local news, sports, comment, entertainment, photos, and video. Follow the Toronto Sun today for reading about the latest music releases, concerts & festivals. Get critics reviews on the newest albums from top artists in country music, rap, rock, indie & more.

feeds.title: Exclaim!
feeds.description: Exclaim! is your daily dose of music news, reporting the goings-on of the best bands and artists from Canada and abroad.

feeds.title: Addicted
feeds.description: Addicted Magazine features the best in Music, Entertainment, Film and TV, Beauty , Fashion, Travel and so much more. Follow this blog for posts about Music written by Aron Harris and Nadia Elkharadly.

feeds.title: FUXWITHIT | Hip-Hop & Electronic Music Blog
feeds.description: While other blogs are focused on clickbait headlines we dedicate our time to finding new music and exploring fresh sounds. With a hip-hop heart and a strong electronic music focus, we cover everything from Rap, Trap, Future Bass, House, Jersey Club and more. In addition to sharing new music we provide in depth reviews, exclusive interviews, guest mixes and more.

feeds.title: Aesthetic Magazine
feeds.description: Aesthetic Magazine produce a variety of content including album and concert reviews, compelling interviews, and more.

feeds.title: The GATE
feeds.description: For over 16 years, The GATE has been obsessed with covering all things entertainment, culture, and style; from film, music and television, to travel, gaming and electronics. The GATE is Toronto's online entertainment magazine.

feeds.title: Elite Music Academy Blog
feeds.description: Elite Music is not just a school; it's an interactive musical community. A performance-based music school in Toronto providing music lessons for piano, guitar, singing, violin, drums, sax, Greek bouzouki and more.

feeds.title: Toronto Arts Academy Blog
feeds.description: Discover all the great things happening at Toronto Arts Academy! Keep up to date with our current events, performances, lesson schedules, and more suprises!

feeds.title: The Harlton Empire
feeds.description: Get the latest music news, videos, photos, interviews, reviews and more.

feeds.title: Toronto Blues Society
feeds.description: Formed in 1985 by a group of enthusiasts who saw legendary blues nightclub Albert's Hall spike blues interest and wanted to protect the stability of Toronto's blues with an organization. This group included Derek Andrews, David Barnard and John Valenteyn, who wanted to ensure that blues music, an indigenous North American art form, was guaranteed a continued presence in Toronto.

feeds.title: Dropout Entertainment
feeds.description: Dropout Entertainment Shares the sounds and stories of bands across the Canada! We're bringing you artists from across Canada, so no matter where you live you can discover live videos and interviews with artists from B.C to the Maritimes and everything in between!

feeds.title: Toronto Blues Diary
feeds.description: Originally from the hills of rural Quebec, now based in Toronto, Brian 'Colorblind' Blain has been performing his unique brand of slow-cooked, solid-groove folk blues for more than 40 years - soulful, thoughtful, always entertaining.

feeds.title: Sidewalk Hustle
feeds.description: One of the world's 100 most influential music blogs according to Style of Sound. Listed in CBC's list of 'Canadian music blogs you need to be reading'. Sidewalk Hustle was launched back in 2007, at first as a weekly music podcast later morphing into a daily blog saturated mainly with local music coverage, fashion news, and culture.

feeds.title: WhatTheHYPE
feeds.description: WhatTheHYPE is a Canadian hiphop community / blog. You're #1 Source for Canadian hiphop content. We find and feature Canadian hiphop artists

feeds.title: Canadian Reggae World Blog
feeds.description: Canadian Reggae World is all about promoting Reggae Music in Canada. The goal is to provide reggae merchandising, originated out of Toronto, Canada whose roots are deep from a Jamaican core.

feeds.title: Country Music Junkies by Patrice Whiffen
feeds.description: Country Music Junkies is your online source for country music. Check out weekly updates of new artists, songs, events, interviews, and insider information. Patrice Whiffen is a radio broadcaster with an inside view of the world of country music.

feeds.title: Indie Music Filter
feeds.description: Toronto-based music blog finding the best new music in the feeds. To the point track features, videos, quick reviews and streaming playlists.

feeds.title: Chart Attack
feeds.description: Chart Attack is a guide to indie and alternative music, based out of Toronto, Canada, online since 1996. They're dedicated in showcasing great music that pushes expectations of genre, and getting to know the people who make it through written features and video features.

feeds.title: Toronto Life
feeds.description: Toronto Life is the destination for people who care about Toronto, the country's most vibrant city, and want to get the most out of it. We provide insight into the personalities and events that shape the landscape, and help readers make smart choices about everything from restaurants and shopping to real estate and culture.

feeds.title: thereviewsarein
feeds.description: Multi-genre music blog with a focus on Canadian music. Your Home for Music News, Reviews, Interviews, Contests, and More!

feeds.title: Music Between Friends
feeds.description: Toronto experimental music blog & podcast.

feeds.title: PeteHatesMusic
feeds.description: PeteHatesMusic is an indie music blog based out of Toronto and Ottawa in Canada. Pete is an award winning Toronto-based indie music blog, CMBIA nominated Music Journalist/Blogger, Prism Prize juror, gummi bear lover.

feeds.title: Women's Musical Club of Toronto News
feeds.description: The Women's Musical Club of Toronto presents an annual series of world-class chamber music concerts by both well-established international and Canadian performers, and exceptional musicians on the threshold of their careers. The WMCT has a special interest in exceptional young Canadian talent and the commissioning of new work by Canadian composers.

feeds.title: TheReviewsAreIn
feeds.description: TheReviewsAreIn exists to share news and more from the music world. We love rock, country, pop, folk, hip-hop, electronic music we're always excited to hear new music from our favourite artists, and new acts on the scene. Our goal is to create content that tells you why we love the music we find and to find new music to love and share.

feeds.title: Grayowl Point
feeds.description: Grayowl Point is a blog focused on the Canadian music scene at large. Their mission is to spread the word about good music. Their team is based in Toronto, they turn an eye to all Canadian provinces and territories.
